ev.q: The percentage of deaths that occurred in a hospital decreased 25.7%, from approximately half (50.2%) in 2000 to 37.3% in 2014.
Percentage was calculated as (deaths occurred in a place/all deaths) x 100.
The percentage of deaths that occurred at a decedent’s home increased 29.5% during 2000–2014.
During 2000–2005, the percentage of deaths that occurred in a nursing home or long-term care facility remained relatively stable, and then decreased 10.1% during 2005–2014.
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Underlying cause of death data, 2000–2014.
The percentage of deaths that occurred in hospice and all other places increased 242.9%, from 3.5% in 2000 to 12.0% in 2014.
